subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “The cafeteria started taking photos of leftover food after lunch.”?
options: A restaurant placed a clear scale near the kitchen to weigh food waste every night.
They liked the food, but they also liked knowing that nothing was wasted.
The photos were posted near the entrance, showing how much food was wasted each day.
Students could see a screen near the office showing how much electricity the panels produced each day.

本文沒有陳述「They liked the food, but they also liked knowing that nothing was wasted.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The photos were posted near the entrance, showing how much food was wasted each day.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Students could see a screen near the office showing how much electricity the panels produced each day.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
